safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the patient’s prior antihistamine trial reduces the completeness of the treatment history and may lead to redundant recommendations or less informed escalation decisions. It is unlikely to directly cause harm because it does not change the diagnosis or introduce a high-risk therapy error.

safety_verdicts.content: Patient has no known drug allergies.

safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failure to document NKDA leaves an important safety field incomplete and can create downstream uncertainty (e.g., delays or repeated questioning before prescribing).
